guard: cotal_channels shows a family follow as its own row, and a channel under it takes its stored-copy health from the family's membership
why: The suite stages a real auth broker and an in-process delivery daemon, and the agent follows fx51fam.> from boot.
H1 reads a channel's health from its own row only, so a durable channel under the family reads degraded while the family's membership serves it.
H2 drops the pattern rows, so the family follow disappears from the list.
H3 gives the family row no health.
H4 renders the family row as an ordinary channel.
The suite prints SUITE COMPLETE on pass and fail alike and refuses a run short of its EXPECTED_CELLS. It imports connector-core source relatively, so it needs no build.
H5 gives a channel read only through a pattern with * a delivery health, so cotal_channels warns of a backstop it never asked for.
H6 reads a family's health from its own row only, so a sub-family the family above stores for reads degraded.

H7 leaves a family whose cleanup is pending unmarked, and H8 renders it as a family still followed. The suite reaches that state live: the agent's credential renews onto one without the family, the broker refuses the resubscription, and the daemon answers the tombstone with an error.

mutations.name: H1 a channel's health ignores a family row above it
mutations.expectRed: a durable channel under the family reads active through the family's membership
mutations.cell: a durable channel under the family reads active through the family's membership
mutations.note: The daemon stores the follower's copies under the family row; the channel itself has none.

mutations.name: H2 the pattern rows are dropped
mutations.expectRed: the family follow is a row of its own, joined, with its membership's health active
mutations.cell: the family follow is a row of its own, joined, with its membership's health active
mutations.note: An agent could not see from cotal_channels that it follows the family.

mutations.name: H3 the family row carries no health
mutations.expectRed: the family follow is a row of its own, joined, with its membership's health active
mutations.cell: the family follow is a row of its own, joined, with its membership's health active
mutations.note: A failed family membership would look like a working one.

mutations.name: H4 cotal_channels renders the family row as an ordinary channel
mutations.expectRed: cotal_channels shows the family follow and its stored copies
mutations.cell: cotal_channels shows the family follow and its stored copies
mutations.note: The row would read as a channel named fx51fam.> with no word of what it covers.

mutations.name: H5 a channel read only through a pattern with * takes delivery health
mutations.find: const stored = mine.some((p) => p === c.channel || (isChannelFamily(p) && subjectMatches(p, c.channel)));
mutations.expectRed: a durable channel followed only through a pattern with * carries no delivery health
mutations.cell: a durable channel followed only through a pattern with * carries no delivery health
mutations.note: A pattern with * asks for no stored copies, so a backstop warning on its channels is false.

mutations.name: H6 a family's health counts its own row only
mutations.replace: deliveryHealth: family ? (daemonMemberships?.some((m) => m.channel === pattern) ? held(pattern) : "degraded") : undefined,
mutations.expectRed: a sub-family with no row of its own reads active through the family above it, whose row stores its posts
mutations.cell: a sub-family with no row of its own reads active through the family above it, whose row stores its posts
mutations.note: The family above stores the sub-family's posts, so the sub-family is held through it.

mutations.name: H7 a family whose cleanup is pending is not marked a family
mutations.expectRed: the family left with its cleanup pending is still a family row, not followed
mutations.cell: the family left with its cleanup pending is still a family row, not followed
mutations.note: Without the mark, a family the broker forced out reads as a concrete channel.

mutations.name: H8 cotal_channels renders a family no longer followed as one still followed
mutations.find:
if (c.follow === "family" && !c.joined)
            return `○ #${c.channel} — family you no longer follow${c.durableUnclosed ? " · durable cleanup pending (§7 backstop may still deliver — retrying)" : ""}`;
mutations.expectRed: cotal_channels shows a family no longer followed with its cleanup pending
mutations.cell: cotal_channels shows a family no longer followed with its cleanup pending
mutations.note: The followed-family line would tell the agent it still gets stored copies.
